description: In relay_client.rs, MtaStsEnforcer evicts expired cache entries only when a new entry is inserted (via the opportunistic sweep in enforce()). A long-lived process that stops receiving new entries for a domain will accumulate expired entries indefinitely, since nothing triggers eviction between insertions. Fix: add a periodic background sweep task (e.g. spawned in the enforcer constructor) that wakes once per policy TTL window and evicts expired entries, or use an existing TTL-aware cache crate.
title: smtp: MtaStsEnforcer TTL eviction is opportunistic-only with no periodic sweep
